MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The monitor fits my broad interest in useful computer accessories, although I do not need a replacement display now.",
    "Audio equipment has some connection to my earlier headset purchase, but that connection alone does not make another pair useful to me now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The CPU coolers, processor and full-tower case assume I am planning a computer build or upgrade; my purchases do not establish that need.",
    "The A40 modification kit and MacBook case require specific equipment that my history does not show I own.",
    "A charger solves a different problem from a USB network adapter, and a tablet mount does not imply I need a dual-monitor stand."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in computer accessories seems to have been stretched into an interest in almost any computer hardware.",
    "Buying one headset or mount seems to have been treated as a reason to buy related equipment without a new need."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent Ethernet adapter and earlier connectivity purchases suggest occasional, specific connection needs rather than a broad upgrade project.",
    "I interact infrequently and need a clear practical reason to choose something; a related product is not enough.",
    "Compatibility matters for accessories, and my history does not establish the devices required by several recommendations."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my interest in computer accessories but infer equipment ownership and upgrade needs that my occasional practical purchases do not establish."
}
